summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the traditional foods served at a Sebt, focusing on the history and preparation of authentic dishes. He highlights specific items like Kibbe, Lahmajine, and Bastelis, while noting that some modern additions like chicken nuggets and cold cuts were introduced in the 1980s.
